name: Mamiya Youko
source:
Similar to Miyabi, one year older Senpai.
Treats the protagonist like her pet.
However, the protagonist doesn't resist at all against those actions...
Everything is because of those breasts!

"Ahaha... Good child.. Hey, come a bit more closer♪"
